name: Axe Bouncer (Combat)
body:
You are particularly skilled with the use of the throwing axe. You can throw an axe in such a manner that it bounces off the ground and up at your target.

Prerequisite(s): Base Attack Bonus +1, Weapon Focus (throwing axe)

Benefit(s): Make a ranged attack made with a –2 penalty, if successful ignore the target’s shield bonus to AC, and ignore any bonus to AC received from teamwork feats such as Shieldwall or Swine’s Head.
